# Generated by tools/s2_germania_dynamics.py --write.
# All dates are AntqDate-validated; pressure is deliberately low-frequency.

# P8.7;STR-GER;TAC-ANN-II;OCD-CHER
antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	content_trigger = { tag = XBK }
	can_start = {
		current_date >= 1.1.1
		current_date < 20.1.1
		country_exists = c:XBK
	}
	can_end = {
		OR = {
			current_date >= 20.1.1
			var:antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress >= 100
		}
	}
	visible = { country_exists = c:XBK }
	on_start = {
		set_variable = { name = antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress value = 0 }
		c:XBK = { add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus }
	}
	on_monthly = {
		c:XBK = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability >= 20 at_war = no }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress add = 3 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { stability >= 0 at_war = yes }
				root = { change_variable = { name = antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress add = 1.5 } }
			}
			else = { root = { change_variable = { name = antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress add = 0.5 } } }
			random_list = {
				1 = { add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus }
				23 = {}
			}
		}
	}
	on_ended = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress } remove_variable = antq_s2_maroboduus_rivalry_resolution_progress }
	}
}
